architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Router use React Router. Shared UI in src/components/. State: local component state, no global state manager yet. CSS: Tailwind. API calls: fetch. Auth: JWT in httpOnly cookie. Ponytail: no SSR, add when SEO needed. No i18n, add when multi-language requested.

tickets.title: Build WelcomeScreen page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch welcome_screen to React. Static page. No auth. Include hero section, CTA buttons. Responsive. Match design 1:1.
acceptance_criteria: CTA buttons link to /beranda (temporary # for now)

tickets.title: Build Login page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch masuk screen to React. Form: email, password. Validation: required fields, email format. Submit: POST /api/auth/login. Success: redirect /beranda. Error: show inline. Password toggle visibility.

tickets.title: Build Register page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch daftar_akun screen to React. Form: name, email, password, confirm password. Validation: required, email format, password match. Submit: POST /api/auth/register. Success: redirect /beranda. Error: show inline.

tickets.title: Build Home page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch beranda_home screen to React. Auth required. Fetch user data, recent orders, featured products. Carousel: auto-rotate, pause on hover. Product cards: link to /detail-produk/:id. Responsive grid.
acceptance_criteria: Auth guard redirect to /masuk if no token

tickets.title: Build Product Detail page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch detail_produk screen to React. Auth required. Fetch product data from /api/products/:id. Image gallery: thumbnails, main image swap. Add to cart: quantity selector, button. Related products: horizontal scroll. Responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Auth guard redirect to /masuk if no token
Add to cart trigger API call

tickets.title: Build Order List page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch daftar_pesanan_saya screen to React. Auth required. Fetch orders from /api/orders. Tabs: all, processing, completed, cancelled. Order cards: status badge, date, total, detail link. Pagination: 10 items/page. Responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Auth guard redirect to /masuk if no token

tickets.title: Build Order Detail page component
tickets.description: Convert Stitch detail_pesanan_transaction_detail screen to React. Auth required. Fetch order from /api/orders/:id. Show: order info, items, payment proof upload, cancellation request button. Payment proof: upload image, preview, submit. Cancellation: link to /ajukan-pembatalan/:id.
acceptance_criteria: Auth guard redirect to /masuk if no token

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation bar: logo, home, orders, notifications, account. Router: React Router v6. Routes: /, /masuk, /daftar, /beranda, /detail-produk/:id, /pesanan-saya, /pesanan/:id, /ajukan-pembatalan/:id, /notifikasi, /admin. Auth guard: redirect to /masuk if no token. 404 page. Responsive navbar: collapse to hamburger on mobile.
